selected_contracts.dnet: Real public application software/documentation explicitly counts,conditions and samples configurations. Input gives 3 substations,16 switch labels,complex three-phase constant-current loads/impedances and no color/quota fields. Actual enumeration constructs rooted forests with roots separated,then by default intersects per-root electric-feasible sets;physical checks reject current/voltage violations. This is not candidate pure graphic+partition common bases. No proof such physical feasible sets are two matroids. DNET1.0/current Graphillion commit compatibility untested.

Backend correctness/scaling and distinct parallel-label encoding remain unverified.
